title: Homeowner Terms: Expedited Build on a Factory Production Order
content:
**Terms.** In classes where it is available, a customer may buy an expedited build before production starts. The expedited target ship date is the request date plus the class expedite lead time in business days; it does not change the committed ship date or the guarantee benchmark. When the order ships after its expedited target date, the expedite fee is waived in full by a waiver naming the fee as its source. An expedite cannot be bought in a class where it is unavailable, and never for a held order.

These terms apply to all Factory Production Orders; whether expedite is available and the expedite lead time are figures of the order's build class.

## Clauses no longer in force

1. Former wording, **no longer in force**: "The expedite fee is the class fee per unit times the units on the order, never less than the class minimum fee, booked on the request date." The fee follows the current basis for expedite fees.
2. Former wording, **no longer in force**: "An expedite can be requested only while the order status is entered." The current wording of this condition reads: the condition that an expedite can be requested only while the order status is entered governs expedite fees alone: neither a remake charge nor a storage fee falls under it, and every expedite fee remains under it.

## Conditions at a glance

| Order situation | Expedite can be bought |
|---|---|
| class where expedite is available, order status entered | yes |
| order on hold | no |
| order in production or later | no |
| class where expedite is unavailable | no |

The order's status is read from the factory order record.

## After the expedite

- The committed ship date and the guarantee benchmark stay as they were.
- If the order ships after the expedited target date, the whole expedite fee is waived by one waiver that names the fee.
- Hypothetical example: a Custom Size Build order with an expedite lead time of 12 business days, requested on a Monday with no federal holiday in the period, has an expedited target ship date on the Wednesday two weeks later. Shipping on that Wednesday keeps the fee; shipping on the Thursday or later brings the full waiver.

superseded_clauses: The expedite fee is the class fee per unit times the units on the order, never less than the class minimum fee, booked on the request date.
An expedite can be requested only while the order status is entered.
